location_exception_reason: Prefabricated wooden houses are manufactured products with nationwide distribution; location in title is a seller attribute (where they operate), not a buyer decision factor. GI or regional-origin claims would be rare and would belong in product description, not title.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words ('Manufacturer', 'Supplier', 'Dealer') are redundant in titles—IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'Prefabricated Wooden House Manufacturer' leaves a complete, accurate product title; the business relationship is not part of what is being sold.
